## FDA Guidance {#fda}

```{=html}
<div class="reg-grid">
  <div class="reg-card reg-fda">
    <div class="reg-agency">FDA, November 2019</div>
    <h4>Adaptive Designs for Clinical Trials of Drugs and Biologics</h4>
    <p>Core FDA guidance on pre-specified adaptations, alpha control, and operational integrity in adaptive trials.</p>
    <a href="https://www.fda.gov/media/78504/download" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Download PDF</a>
  </div>
  <div class="reg-card reg-fda">
    <div class="reg-agency">FDA, June 2026 <span class="reg-new">New</span></div>
    <h4>Master Protocols for Drug and Biological Product Development (Revised Draft)</h4>
    <p>Revised draft guidance issued June 24, 2026, replacing the December 2023 draft. Provides updated recommendations on the design, conduct, analysis, and regulatory submission of trials run under a master protocol, and adds a new section on evaluating drug effects across multiple diseases or disease subtypes in basket trials. Also details communication expectations between master protocol sponsors, drug sponsors, and the FDA, and expands guidance on informed consent. Open for comment through August 24, 2026. Docket: FDA-2023-D-5259.</p>
    <a href="https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/06/24/2026-12620/master-protocols-for-drug-and-biological-product-development-draft-guidance-for-industry" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Federal Register notice</a>
  </div>
  <div class="reg-card reg-fda">
    <div class="reg-agency">FDA, December 2023</div>
    <h4>Decentralized Clinical Trials for Drugs, Biological Products, and Devices</h4>
    <p>Final guidance on remote assessments, local healthcare providers, and digital data collection in decentralized trials.</p>
    <a href="https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents" target="_blank" rel="noopener">FDA guidance portal</a>
  </div>
  <div class="reg-card reg-fda">
    <div class="reg-agency">FDA, January 2025</div>
    <h4>Considerations for the Design and Conduct of Externally Controlled Trials</h4>
    <p>Guidance on using real-world data as a control arm, with particular relevance for rare diseases and pediatric populations.</p>
    <a href="https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents" target="_blank" rel="noopener">FDA guidance portal</a>
  </div>
  <div class="reg-card reg-fda">
    <div class="reg-agency">FDA, January 2026 <span class="reg-new">New</span></div>
    <h4>Use of Bayesian Methodology in Clinical Trials of Drug and Biological Products (Draft)</h4>
    <p>Landmark draft guidance covering Bayesian approaches to primary inference in pivotal trials, adaptive designs, rare disease trials, and incorporation of external data including real-world evidence. Covers pre-specification requirements, prior selection, success criteria, and simulation. Open for public comment; comments due March 13, 2026. Docket: FDA-2025-D-3217.</p>
    <a href="https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/01/12/2026-00325/use-of-bayesian-methodology-in-clinical-trials-of-drug-and-biological-products-draft-guidance-for" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Federal Register notice</a>
  </div>

  <div class="reg-card reg-fda">
    <div class="reg-agency">FDA, February 2026 <span class="reg-new">New</span></div>
    <h4>Plausible Mechanism Framework for Individualized Therapies Targeting Specific Genetic Conditions (Draft)</h4>
    <p>Draft guidance establishing a framework for approval of highly individualized therapies (genome editing, RNA-based) for ultra-rare diseases where conventional randomized trials are not feasible. Describes conditions for meeting the substantial evidence of effectiveness standard via mechanistic evidence. Notes master protocols as a design option for evaluating multiple variants under a single application. Open for comment; comments due April 27, 2026. Docket: FDA-2026-D-1256.</p>
    <a href="https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/02/25/2026-03713/considerations-for-the-use-of-the-plausible-mechanism-framework-to-develop-individualized-therapies" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Federal Register notice</a>
  </div>

</div>
```

## EMA Guidance {#ema}

```{=html}
<div class="reg-grid">
  <div class="reg-card reg-ema">
    <div class="reg-agency">EMA, March 2021</div>
    <h4>Guideline on Adaptive Designs in Clinical Trials</h4>
    <p>EMA guidance on adaptive methodology, Type I error control, and regulatory interaction for EU development programs.</p>
    <a href="https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/adaptive-designs-clinical-trials-scientific-guideline" target="_blank" rel="noopener">EMA website</a>
  </div>
  <div class="reg-card reg-ema">
    <div class="reg-agency">EMA, 2022</div>
    <h4>Reflection Paper on Use of Real-World Data in Regulatory Decision-Making</h4>
    <p>EMA framework for when and how real-world data can support marketing authorization applications.</p>
    <a href="https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/human-regulatory-overview/research-development/real-world-evidence-ema" target="_blank" rel="noopener">EMA website</a>
  </div>
</div>
```

## ICH Guidelines {#ich}

```{=html}
<div class="reg-grid">
  <div class="reg-card reg-ich">
    <div class="reg-agency">ICH, November 2019</div>
    <h4>E9(R1): Estimands and Sensitivity Analysis</h4>
    <p>The international standard for defining the target of estimation in clinical trials. Applies across FDA, EMA, and PMDA regions.</p>
    <a href="https://www.ich.org/page/efficacy-guidelines" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ICH website</a>
  </div>
  <div class="reg-card reg-ich">
    <div class="reg-agency">ICH, 2024</div>
    <h4>E20: Adaptive Clinical Trials (Draft)</h4>
    <p>New ICH guideline harmonizing regulatory expectations for adaptive designs across international regions.</p>
    <a href="https://www.ich.org/page/efficacy-guidelines" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ICH website</a>
  </div>
</div>
```
